locations.title: Staff of Ice Wonder Weapon Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Starting at Round 8, a Shock Mimic will begin to spawn.
- Killing the Shock Mimic will drop the [Monocle](#loc=954982) floating above the ground.
- Grab the Monocle, then head over to one of two paintings on the map:
   - [Orion Painting](#loc=954991)
      - Shoot the nearby Lantern Traps until the Lantern appears at [this location](#loc=954990) to show the constellation on the painting.
   - [Taurus Painting](#loc=954993)
      - Shoot the nearby Lantern Traps until the Lantern appears at [this location](#loc=954996) to show the constellation on the painting.
- For each, shoot the symbols in order from 1 to 10.
   - The symbols are treated as roman numerals: The slash is one, the V is five, and the X is ten. Order should be /, //, ///, /V, V, V/, V//, V///, /X, X.
- Afterwards, survive the lockdown until the [Head Piece](#loc=954992) and the [Staff](#loc=954997) spawn, then grab each of them.
- Head to the [Altar](#loc=954998) and place the items in, then defend it until the Wonder Weapon is ready to be grabbed.

locations.title: Ull's Arrow/Sekhmet's Vigor Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, acquire the [Ice Staff](#loc=955032) Wonder Weapon at the end of the [Staff of Ice Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954946).
   - This may also be acquired from the Mystery Box.
- Around the map, quickly shoot three of the [Lantern Traps](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-the-tomb?search=lantern_trap%20%26%26%20category%3A27396) with the Ice Staff.
- Head into the Dark Aether Nexus and, on three floating rocks floating above the area, runes will appear.
- Remember and shoot the runes with the Ice Staff, causing one of the portals to deactivate.
- Head to the opposite side of the deactivated portal and shoot the three runes that were on the rocks.
- Head through the portal and interact with the orb.
- Follow the orb around the Dark Aether Nexus until it reaches the [Altar](#loc=954998).
   - This needs to be completed with all players present.
- Once in the Altar, interact with the Altar with the Ice Staff to upgrade it to Ull's Arrow/Sekhmet's Vigor.

locations.title: The Tomb Main Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Firstly, obtain the [Ice Staff](#loc=955032) from the [Staff of Ice Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954946) and upgrade it to the Ull's Arrow with the [Ull's Arrow/Sekhmet's Vigor Easter Egg](#loc=954947).
- Around the map are four statues that need to be shot and completed in order:
   1. Vermin Ritual
      - First, shoot the [Vermin Statue](#loc=955005) in the Dark Aether Nexus with a Sekhmet's Vigor shot, then interact with the statue.
      - Next, head to the Dig Site and interact with the [Vermin Statue](#loc=955006) there.
      - A lockdown will start. Kill all the Vermin that spawn until the lockdown completes, then interact with the statue again.
      - Carry the power to the Vermin Statue in the Dark Aether Nexus.
         - The nearby Gateway will close, and getting hit twice will fail the event.
      - Interact with the Vermin Statue to complete the ritual.
   2. Parasite Ritual
      - First, shoot the [Parasite Statue](#loc=955003) in the Dark Aether Nexus with a Sekhmet's Vigor shot, then interact with the statue.
      - Next, head to the Shrine of the Hierophants and interact with the [Parasite Statue](#loc=955004).
      - A lockdown will start. Kill all the parasites that spawn and grab the orbs they drop. Place them into the statue until the lockdown completes, then interact with the statue again.
      - Carry the power to the Parasite Statue in the Dark Aether Nexus.
         - The nearby Gateway will close, and getting hit twice will fail the event.
      - Interact with the Parasite Statue to complete the ritual.
   3. Doppelghast Ritual
      - First, shoot the [Doppelghast Statue](#loc=955007) in the Dark Aether Nexus with a Sekhmet's Vigor shot, then interact with the statue.
      - Next, head to the Ossuary and interact with the [Doppelghast Statue](#loc=955008).
      - A lockdown will start. Kill all the Doppelghasts that spawn until the lockdown completes, then interact with the statue again.
      - Carry the power to the Doppelghast Statue in the Dark Aether Nexus.
         - The nearby Gateway will close, and getting hit twice will fail the event.
      - Interact with the Doppelghast Statue to complete the ritual.
   4. Amalgam Ritual
      - First, shoot the [Amalgam Statue](#loc=955009) in the Dark Aether Nexus with a Sekhmet's Vigor shot, then interact with the statue.
      - Next, head to the Subterranean Temple and interact with the [Amalgam Statue](#loc=955010) there.
      - A lockdown will start. Kill the Amalgam that spawns, occasionally killing the additional zombies as well that are connected to it, until the lockdown completes, then interact with the statue again.
      - Carry the power to the Amalgam Statue in the Dark Aether Nexus.
         - The nearby Gateway will close, and getting hit twice will fail the event.
      - Interact with the Amalgam Statue to complete the ritual.
- Once all four rituals are done, a door on the north-east side of the Dark Aether Nexus will spawn. Interacting with it will start the boss fight.

locations.title: Friendly Skulls Side Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Around the Ossuary, there are four skulls with X's on their head:
   1. [X Skull](#loc=955020)
   2. [X Skull](#loc=955021)
   3. [X Skull](#loc=955022)
   4. [X Skull](#loc=955023)
- Shoot them in order with a gun with the Brain Rot Ammo Mod on it in quick succession to spawn a group of friendly zombies.

locations.title: Ray Gun Gems Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- With Death Perception, use a [Shovel](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-the-tomb?search=shovel%20%26%26%20category%3A27411) to dig up [Dig Spots](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-the-tomb?search=dig_spot%20%26%26%20category%3A27416) around the map and collect three gems.
- Head to the [Gem Statue](#loc=955026) and interact with it.
- Kill the Doppleghasts that spawn to receive random loot and a Ray Gun.

locations.title: Generators Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- In the Dig Site, there are two generators:
   - [Generator](#loc=955052)
   - [Generator](#loc=955053)
- Shooting both with a weapon equipped with the Dead Wire Ammo Mod will spawn essence and a Full Power power up.

   - [Vase](#loc=955049)
   - [Vase](#loc=955050)
   - [Vase](#loc=955051)
   - [Vase](#loc=955055)
   - [Vase](#loc=955056)
   - [Vase](#loc=955057)
   - [Vase](#loc=955058)
   - [Vase](#loc=955059)
- After destroying the tenth one, it'll drop Self-Revive Kits as well as Brain Rot Ammo Mods.

   - [Headphones](#loc=955063)
   - [Headphones](#loc=955064)

locations.title: Flying Rocks Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside the Dark Aether Nexus, one of the rocks floating in the sky will be electrifying.
- Shoot it, and rocks will start rotating around in the sky.
- Quickly shoot every flying rock to receive a Raw Aetherium Crystal and a Cryofreeze Ammo Mod in front of the [Altar](#loc=954998).

locations.title: Waterfall Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside the Dark Aether Nexus are two waterfalls:
   - [Waterfall](#loc=955069)
   - [Waterfall](#loc=955070)
- Hit both of them with a Cryo attack quickly to receive a free Aether tool.
   - The rarity of the Aether tool depends on the current round.

locations.title: Statue Says Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Head to the Tombs and walk over to the [Statue Wall](#loc=955072).
- Shoot the head of the fallen statue and the statues on the wall will light up.
- Once complete, shoot the heads of the statues in the same order one at a time.
- If completed correctly, a variety of loot and a Brain Rot Ammo Mod will drop on the ground.

locations.title: Free Perk Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- Inside the Ossuary, there are six unlit braziers around the room:
   - [Brazier](#loc=955075)
   - [Brazier](#loc=955076)
   - [Brazier](#loc=955077)
   - [Brazier](#loc=955078)
   - [Brazier](#loc=955079)
   - [Brazier](#loc=955080)
- Light each one either with a Molotov or a weapon with the Napalm Burst ammo mod.
- Once the last one is lit, a Free Perk power up will spawn in the center of the room.

locations.title: Aether - The Tomb Mix Song Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- After completing the [Staff of Ice Wonder Weapon Easter Egg](#loc=954946), head back to either the [Orion Painting](#loc=954991) or the [Taurus Painting](#loc=954993).
- Shoot the symbols signifying 1 - 1 - 5, then quickly head to the other painting and also shoot the symbols signifying 1 - 1 - 5 to play the song.

locations.title: Golden Armor Easter Egg
locations.description:
**Steps:**
- First, head to the Dark Aether Nexus and melee open two wooden boxes and pick up the statue heads inside:
   - [Statue Head](#loc=955093)
   - [Statue Head](#loc=955094)
- Then, head to the Dig site and place them on both [Roman Statue](https://mapgenie.io/call-of-duty-black-ops-6/maps/zombies-the-tomb?search=roman_statue%20%26%26%20category%3A27416).
- Once both are placed, interact with one to be taken down to 1HP with multiple HVTs spawning.
- Once they are killed, interact with the second one to do the same lockdown again, with different HVTs.
- If both are completed, the [Gold Armor Vest](#loc=955097) wall buy will spawn, allowing for armor to automatically regenerate.
   - The wall buy for the armor doesn't cost any essence.
